WITH january_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status IN ('completed', 'paid')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.04
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN amount_minor / 1.0 * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM january_orders;

WITH currency_rules(currency, usd_factor, minor_unit_scale) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.04::DECIMAL(18,8), 100::DECIMAL(18,0)),
        ('JPY', 0.0066::DECIMAL(18,8), 1::DECIMAL(18,0))
)
SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor * cr.usd_factor / cr.minor_unit_scale) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN currency_rules AS cr
    ON cr.currency = o.currency
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

WITH fx_rates(currency, usd_factor, minor_units_per_unit) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.08, 100.0),
        ('JPY', 0.0068, 1.0)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.amount_minor,
        o.currency,
        fx.usd_factor,
        fx.minor_units_per_unit
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN fx_rates AS fx
      ON fx.currency = o.currency
    WHERE c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status IN ('completed', 'paid', 'fulfilled')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-08-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01'
)

        / minor_units_per_unit
        * usd_factor
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders;

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) AS refunded_minor
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
     AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN refunds r
      ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.currency, o.amount_minor
)
SELECT SUM(
    CASE currency
        WHEN 'EUR' THEN (amount_minor - refunded_minor) * 1.04
        WHEN 'JPY' THEN (amount_minor - refunded_minor) * 0.0064
    END
) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue;

WITH currency_rates(currency, usd_factor, minor_unit) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.08, 100.0),
        ('JPY', 0.0067, 1.0)
),
eligible_orders AS (

    FROM orders o

),
refunds AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount_minor / eo.minor_unit * eo.usd_factor), 0.0) AS refunds_usd

    WHERE rf.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'

)
SELECT gross.gross_usd - refunds.refunds_usd AS net_revenue_usd

CROSS JOIN refunds;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
  AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;
